text: aaj LIC policy ki details padhi. kam se kam mere jaane ke baad mummy papa ko kuch toh milega
saare passwords aur bank details ek diary mein likh ke rakh diye hain. bhai ko pata chal jayega kya karna hai
mummy papa ko koi aur baccha milna chahiye tha. main toh bas bojh hoon, zyada time tak nahi rahunga
main gayab ho jaun toh kisi ko farak nahi padega. kabhi bhi nahi
shayad aakhri baar ghar ka khana kha raha hoon. aaj sabko dhyan se dekh raha tha
apne saare sweaters roommate ko de diye. iss baar sardi mein zaroorat nahi padegi
counsellor ko bol diya sab theek hai, koi bura khayal nahi aata. jhooth bola, usne maan liya
kamra saaf kar diya, sabke liye chitthi likh di. baad mein kisi ko pareshani na ho
thank you sabko jo kabhi bhi mere saath acche the. aur sorry, sabse. sach mein
roz subah uthne se thak gayi hoon yaar. har din ek saza lagta hai
bas sab kuch ruk jaye. hamesha ke liye. kuch nahi chahiye ab

saari savings choti behen ke account mein daal di. aage usko zyada zaroorat padegi

sab bolte hain time ke saath theek ho jayega. maine decide kar liya hai, main wait nahi karunga
therapist ko bola ab main bilkul theek hoon aur agle mahine ke sessions cancel kar diye. ab zaroorat nahi
insta se saari photos delete kar di. log jaldi bhool jayenge mujhe aise
socho mere bina ghar mein kitni shanti hogi. sach mein yahi sochta rehta hoon
aaj papa se phone pe baat ki, poori call mein mann hi mann alvida bol raha tha
so jaun aur subah aankh hi na khule, isse accha kuch nahi ho sakta
mere paudhe padosi aunty ko de diye. unko koi chahiye jo yahan rahe
PF mein nominee update kar diya. bas saare loose ends tie kar raha hoon
kal last exam hai aur sach bolu toh mere liye har cheez ka last hai
office mein kisi ko pata bhi nahi chalega. monday ko mere tickets kisi aur ko de denge bas
mummy ne poocha khana khaya, theek ho? haan bol diya. ab jhooth bolna aasan lagta hai kyunki farak nahi padta
PG ke peeche wali railway line raat 2 baje kitni shaant hoti hai. wahi sochti rehti hoon
hafton se dimaag mein sabko bye bol raha hoon. aaj best friend ko bol bhi diya
jinse udhaar liya tha sabko paise lauta diye, library ki books bhi. saaf hisaab ke saath jaana hai
placement ki tension nahi hai ab. jaldi kisi cheez ki tension nahi rahegi 🙂
usko koi aisi ladki milni chahiye jo tooti hui na ho. jaldi mauka mil jayega usko

phone ki screen kyun theek karwau. itna lamba chalana hi nahi hai

har refill se thodi goliyan bacha ke rakh raha hoon is mahine. bas aise hi

poore hafte hostel mein kisi ko pata nahi chala main gaya hua tha. main kasol mein tha bhai 😂

bas ye semester khatam ho jaye yaar. friday tak 4 assignments

3 mahine pune mein training hai toh paudhe padosi aunty ko de diye

aur MBA colleges mein apply nahi karna, first choice mein ho gaya!!!
diwali ki ticket nahi li kyunki iss baar poori family bangalore aa rahi hai 🪔
savings finally FD mein daal di. papa ek saal se bol rahe the
ek mahine ke liye insta delete. pehle exams, reels baad mein
is exam week ke baad 14 ghante sona hai aur kisi se baat nahi karni
office mein kisi ko farak nahi padega agar ek din chhutti lu, toh teen le raha hoon 😌
aaj airport pe best friend ko bye bola, canada ja rahi hai masters ke liye. proud bhi hoon, udaas bhi

library ki saari books lauta di aur fine bhi bhar diya. naya semester, saaf shuruaat
therapist ne bola main kaafi better hoon, ab mahine mein ek session. proud hoon khud pe
chai wale bhaiya ko pehle pata chalega main nahi aaya, classmates ko baad mein 😂

agle weekend ke trek ke liye shimla ke paas sabse uncha viewpoint dhoondh raha hoon 🏔️

phone ki screen tooti hai par theek karwane ka point nahi, agle mahine naya le raha hoon

school chhodne se pehle sab teachers ke liye thank you card likhe. verma ma'am ro padi
group project mein jo bhi bola uske liye sorry yaar, neend kam thi. pizza meri taraf se

placements ke baad ek hafta sota rahunga, koi call mat karna
notice period jaldi khatam ho bas, nayi job start karni hai. 23 din baaki
abroad internship ja raha hoon toh room ka saaman baant raha hoon. wing mein gadde ke liye ladai ho rahi hai
